name: Tanjiro Kamado
summary: Tanjiro Kamado is the main protagonist of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba. After his family was slaughtered by Muzan Kibutsuji and his sister Nezuko was turned into a demon, Tanjiro began training under Sakonji Urokodaki to become a Demon Slayer and find a way to restore Nezuko's humanity. Following his initial training, Tanjiro became a skilled swordsman capable of using Water Breathing and later began awakening the Hinokami Kagura inherited from his father.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Total Concentration Breathing and Water Breathing

notes: Tanjiro's Post-Demon Slayer Training key. His normal physical abilities are 9-A, with Constant Flux providing additional power and Hinokami Kagura reaching 8-C.
